title: Deep neural network predicts HCC recurrence after liver transplantation
summary: MoRAL-AI, a residual-block deep neural network, was derived in 349 and validated in 214 of 563 Korean liver transplant recipients with HCC. In validation its c-index was 0.75, versus 0.64 for the Milan, 0.69 for MoRAL, 0.62 for UCSF and 0.50 for up-to-seven and Kyoto criteria. Tumor diameter carried the largest weight. The study is retrospective.
ai_technology: Residual-block deep neural network (MoRAL-AI) for time-to-recurrence prediction
organization: Seoul National University College of Medicine

evidence.tested: Independent validation cohort (n=214) compared with conventional criteria.
evidence.unknown: Prospective performance and use in transplant selection are not reported; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Predicted recurrence risk from clinical features.
